on Wednesday named Joanne Wilson as its new chief financial officer, joining the board and executive committee “some time in 2027”, according to a statement.
Wilson, currently the CFO of WPP
Jhangiani joined Diageo as CFO in May 2024 and ​was briefly interim CEO before Dave Lewis took over the top role this ‌year.

Wilson’s appointment comes as CEO Dave Lewis drives a major restructuring at Diageo, marked by senior executive departures and layoffs. Last month, Lewis announced a $1B cost-cutting plan to help the world’s largest spirits maker navigate sustained weak growth.
Wilson and Lewis have both previously worked together at Tesco.

title: Diageo names WPP’s Joanne Wilson as CFO starting in 2027
